text:
Predicates:
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.
AmericanCity(y) ::: y is an American city.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Novel(y) ::: y is a novel.
WrittenBy(y, x) ::: y is written by x.
Author(x, y) ::: x is the author of y.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
FamilyHistory(y) ::: y is Family History.
FamilySecrets(x) ::: x is Family Secrets.
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
BG ::: background information indicator.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
Year2003 ::: 2003.
Boston ::: Boston.

Premises:
[BG] ∀x (BornIn(x, y) ∧ AmericanCity(y) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in an American city, then the person is American.
[BG] ∀y ∀x ((Novel(y) ∧ WrittenBy(y, x)) → NovelWriter(x)) ::: If a book is a novel and written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
Author(daniShapiro, familyHistory) ∧ Book(familyHistory) ∧ Year(2003) ∧ FamilyHistory(familyHistory) ∧ FamilySecrets(daniShapiro) ∧ Created(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro is the author of Family History, which is a novel written in 2003, and Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
Book(familyHistory) ::: Family History is a book.
Created(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
Boston ::: Boston is an American city.

Conclusion:
BornIn(daniShapiro, Boston) ::: Dani Shapiro was born in Boston.
